title: Figures 12–13. SP-100 Space Nuclear Power System cutaway and NEP concept vehicle artwork
description: Figure 12 is a labeled cutaway illustration titled "Cutaway View of the SP-100 Space Nuclear Power System," captioned as an illustration of the 100 kWe SP-100 nuclear reactor. Figure 13 shows two artist concepts: left, the 100-kWe Jupiter Icy Moons (JIMO) spacecraft near Jupiter and its moons; right, a 100-MWe-class piloted NEP vehicle at Mars. Captioned "Figure 13. Nuclear Electric Propulsion (NEP) Concept Vehicles."
